objectives:
****** 本學期課程預計採用創新教學實踐方法，結合探究式學習與PBL學習法，需要自律的學生進行自我學習及探索。******

This course is divided into two parts, including computer vision and deep learning. The first part introduces the critical algorithms, methodologies, and applications. The second part is the deep learning-based models that are widely used in computer vision applications.
content:
Basics of computer vision, such as camera model, image formation, filtering, featuring and matching, and recognition.
Popular deep learning models used in computer vision, such as CNN, RNN, LSTM, GAN, etc.
books:
No official textbook.
Computer Vision: Algorithms and Applications. https://szeliski.org/Book/
Multiple View Geometry in Computer Vision. https://www.cambridge.org/core/books/multiple-view-geometry-in-computer-vision/0B6F289C78B2B23F596CAA76D3D43F7A
Deep Learning book by Ian Goodfellow, et al. http://www.deeplearningbook.org/
grading_policy:
1. Programming assignments: 50％
2. Project proposal: 20％
3. Final project: 30％

系所:限機械工程學系。年級:限四年級。
